source_text: Filii de ancillis et liberis — diversitas vocationum in domo Iacob. Haec Homiliae XIII finis. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Sons from maidservants and freewomen — diversity of-callings in house of-Jacob. These of-Homily XIII end. Amen.
